title: Adam Back-backed Bitcoin treasury Future Holdings set for takeover by H100
summary: Adam Back-backed Bitcoin treasury Future Holdings has agreed to a takeover proposal from Sweden-listed H100 Group as it eyes expansion into Switzerland.

title: Stablecoins, sanctions and surveillance: Why 2025 reshaped crypto’s regulatory reality
summary: From record onchain volumes to geopolitics-driven crypto crime, 2025 structurally shifted how regulators and institutions engaged with digital assets, with stablecoins at the center.

title: Fed rate cuts under fire: 5 things to know in Bitcoin this week
summary: Bitcoin injected volatility as legal action against the Federal Reserve combined with market nerves over geopolitics at the start of a key week for inflation data.

title: SEC delays PENGU and T. Rowe crypto ETFs as Grayscale seeks options green light
summary: The SEC delayed decisions on two crypto ETFs and opened public comments on options tied to a Grayscale multi-asset crypto fund.

title: Tether’s role in Venezuela, Iran highlights the duality of stablecoins
summary: The dual life of stablecoins: A lifeline for citizens and a tool for sanctioned entities involved in Venezuela and Iran's economic crises.

title: Most US debanking cases stem from government pressure, report says
summary: Cato Institute analyst Nicholas Anthony argues the US Congress needs to reform the Bank Secrecy Act, repeal confidentiality laws and end reputational risk regulation to address debanking.

title: South Korea to lift ban on corporate crypto investment: Report
summary: South Korea’s FSC reportedly shared guidelines allowing listed companies to invest up to 5% of equity in the top 20 cryptocurrencies, ending a 2017 ban.

title: ​​Top UK Labour lawmakers push to ban political donations made in crypto
summary: The chairs of seven UK government committees have asked for a ban on crypto donations to be added to an elections bill set to be introduced soon.

title: Ethereum needs better decentralized stablecoins: Vitalik Buterin
summary: It isn’t a good idea to fully back a stablecoin with a single fiat currency, because if that nation-state fails, so will the stablecoin, argues Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin.

title: Crypto YouTube views sink to lowest level since early 2021, ‘it’s not just X'
summary: Crypto content viewership on YouTube has plunged over the past three months, signaling bear market conditions as retail interest in crypto continues to decline.
